name: Reacting Plug Flow 20x4
description: 2D strip carrying a one-step irreversible A -> B reaction in an inert N2 carrier, driven end to end from this case file through CaseReader/CaseBuilder/ProjectRunner. TD-001's production-reachability case: it is the first case in the repository whose physics.json declares a reaction mechanism. The mechanism, thermochemistry and initial state reuse P18.7's qualified reference problem (A = 5.0, Ea = 30000 J/mol, M = 0.028 for every species, cp = 1000, h_f,B = -2e6 J/kg, T_0 = 1000 K) so the chemistry it exercises is already validated against an independent arbitrary-precision implementation. All three species are declared explicitly, including the inert carrier: this codebase has no implicit carrier species and never normalises a composition.
